# The Rainbow colour, fix/long189 (Minecraft 1.21.11, the workflow's usual 1280x720, GUI scale 3, the demo song). The
# colour is now worked out from the clock's remainder in whole nanoseconds instead of from the clock as a float. The bug
# only showed on a computer that had been on for days (System.nanoTime() counts from when it started), and a GitHub runner
# has only been up a short while, so this is a check that nothing else changed: main and the branch look the same.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/long189 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/long189.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/long189 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/long189.txt
#
# What to look for (the same on both):
# 1. long189-rainbow_00.._07: the Floating lyrics in Rainbow, half a second apart (3.5 s in all). The colour moves on
#    a little from each frame to the next, the same way round, about a fifth of the way round the colours over the
#    eight frames (a full turn takes 16 s). No frame jumps back or skips far ahead. Both runs start at another point of
#    the turn, so compare how far it moves, not the colour itself.
# 2. long189-themes: the Look tab searched for "Pick a look": the Rainbow tile's name shows a rainbow across its letters,
#    each letter a little further round than the one before, as before; the other tiles as on main.
# Not in a game here: a computer that has been on for days (the unit test RainbowCycleTest counts the colours a second
# gets at 2 to 52 days).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8
set placement FLOATING
set colorMode RAINBOW
sleep 2
burst long189-rainbow 8 500
wait burst long189-rainbow wrote
sleep 1

gui 0
search Pick a look
sleep 2
shot long189-themes
close
sleep 1
